title: plugin-chatbot: read the `verify` / `done` build-progress phases on the `build-verify` part — the receiver cloud#2172's ruling A re-files (objectui#7388 piece 2, never carried)
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Why this card exists.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2172's ruling (letter A, maintainer 「同意」, `5696721651`) orders that "the objectui receiver card is re-filed against a declared vocabulary". It was never re-filed:
- objectui#7388, the old receiver card, closed on 2026-09-27 on the maintainer's word with piece 2 "not tracked here" (`5852222070`);
- the cloud sender is now built (cloud PR #2721) and held as a draft until cloud's `.objectui-sha` carries a receiver (seat review `6062743414`).

This card is that receiver. The direction is ruled, so this is not a decision card.

## The wire shape it reads

Taken from cloud PR #2721's **Wire shape** section, which the cloud seat keeps authoritative:
- part type `data-build-progress` (`BUILD_PROGRESS_FRAME_TYPE`, `@objectstack/spec/ai`);
- part id **`build-verify`**, stable within a turn and separate from `build-progress` (the `apply_blueprint` tree). Both can be on one message, and this one never overwrites the tree;
- a hop: `{ phase: 'verify', hop, tool }`;
- the exit: `{ phase: 'done' }`;
- every `data` parses with `BuildProgressFrameSchema`, and every phase is in `BUILD_PROGRESS_PHASES`.

## What the receiver does today (cloud's reading at objectui `f1781be3`)

In `packages/plugin-chatbot/src`:
- `mapMessages.ts:832`: `extractBuildProgress` takes the last `data-build-progress` part on the message, whatever its id;
- `:841`: any phase other than `data` / `done` is coerced to `structure`;
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` renders `BuildProgressPanel` from it.

So a `build-verify` part would replace the finished build tree and read "Building your app…".

## Scope

1. `extractBuildProgress` keeps the `build-progress` tree and the `build-verify` part apart, keyed by part id. A `build-verify` part never displaces the tree.
2. The `verify` phase renders its own line (for example "Checking the change… step N"), and `done` closes it. The phase values are read from the spec vocabulary, ⛔ not restated.
3. An unknown phase is surfaced as unknown (a warning), not coerced to `structure`: the ruling's "an unknown phase value is something the receiver can warn about".
4. Copy goes through `packages/i18n`, like the panel's other strings (objectui#8888's keys).

## Acceptance

- A message carrying cloud PR #2721's measured frames shows the finished tree **and** a verify line that advances per hop and closes on `done`.
- Control: a message with only `build-progress` is unchanged.
- An unknown phase is not rendered as "Building".

## Unlock for cloud

objectstack-ai/cloud#2172 unlocks when cloud's `.objectui-sha` carries this card's merge (the install face). Cloud PR #2721 is then readied.
